text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When it comes to training or anything else in life, Tosen Jordan tackles things head-on and with honesty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not one to deny a sincere request for help, Biwa Hayahide offers Jordan private instruction, concluding with the ultimate secret to victory…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race is upon us. Depending on who you ask, Gold Ship is either not in the running at all or the ultimate favorite to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But who cares about that?! She's still Tosen Jordan's rival. It's time to decide who's the number one dummy!
